newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP rises on UAP /AXA deal.
newsitem.headline: BNP rises on UAP /AXA deal.

text.p: Shares in French bank Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) jumped 3.05 percent to 206 francs at the opening of trade following the announcement of an alliance between insurers AXA and Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP).
BNP has a 17 percent stake in UAP, making it the biggest shareholder in the company which was privatised in 1994.
Share dealers said that BNP was likely to make a capital loss on the transaction because the share swap price of the AXA/UAP deal would be below the price at which BNP acquired its stake.
An industry source said earlier the deal would be based on a share-swap. The two companies have not issued any details yet. A news conference has been slated for 1200 gmt.
But the swap would be above recent UAP market prices, reducing BNP's exposure to a capital loss, they said.
